name: Maulo Shadowmore
original_name: マウロ・シャドウモア
source:
[i]"...Don't you think it's about time we finish this? We know how we're gonna do it, after all."[/i]

[i]Devoted and Fanatic Brotherhood[/i]

A brusque and taciturn top star.

One half of the popular unit "Shadowmore." He joined the industry because of his twin, Loa's, urging, but he displays exceptional singing and dancing skills. He's a perfect pop star, besides his stiff expressions.

He doesn't care much for others, but is sweet on his family. Though he scolds Loa for being too unrestrained and failing to take care of themself, he looks after them anyway. A true younger brother. 

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english/characters/?page=maulo]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
